_about: AAPS preferences that Nightscout does NOT carry, needed to rebuild the oref1/autoISF profile object.
Values: decrypted preferences export 2026-09-07_2049_25_full.json (Markus), completed from devicestatus.configuration and consoleError.
Everything under 'nightscout', 'insulin', 'safety', 'smb', 'autoisf', 'activity_monitor', 'flags' is copied 1:1 into the
profile handed to determine_basal.py, so a VDF line  'profile  autoISF_max  1.3'  still overrides any of them per run.
Glucose values in this file are given in the AAPS/oref internal unit mg/dl unless the key name says otherwise.
Keys marked in '_assumed' were not in the export summary and are set to AAPS/autoISF defaults or inferred from consoleError.

activity_monitor._source_of_state: Nightscout has no step counts. The activity state per loop is taken from the original consoleError line 'Activity monitor ...' and translated into synthetic step counts that reproduce that state, so the scale factors above stay tunable. The export keys steps_activity_detected / steps_inactivity_detected are runtime states (they flip with the user's movement) and are not imported. activity_ratio is a runtime state too (1.0 / 0.835 / 0.67 across the exports) and is computed per loop, not configured.

profile_history._about: Changes made by the user, for confounder tracking in optimization reports (local time Europe/Zurich).

Checked against the printed 'SMB delivery ratio set to interpolated value' lines: 36 reproduces 236/236 (06.Sep) and 112/112 (07.Sep), 18 reproduces 229/229 (15.Sep) and 21/21 (10.Oct). profile_history rewinds loops before the change to 36.

_assumed.autoisf.autoISF_max: 1.5 since 2026-09-07 20:23 local; the replay uses the value valid at each loop time when profile_history says so (see ns_profile.py)
_assumed.flags.low_temptarget_lowers_sensitivity: true per export. Until 2026-10-17 it was pinned false because the phone never printed 'Sensitivity ratio set to ... based on temp target' at TT 5.5 = 99 mg/dl; the reason is Constants.NORMAL_TARGET_MGDL = 99 (AAPS >= 3.4.2.1), so 99 < 99 is false - the port now uses normal_target 99 on the 3.3 path and the flag is back to the export value.
_assumed.flags.normal_target: 99 = Constants.NORMAL_TARGET_MGDL of AAPS >= 3.4.2.1 (not in the export); the phone compares temp targets against it for exercise / resistance mode
